channel.title: Nolon Beta Changelog
channel.description: Most recent beta changes with links to updates.

item.description: ## nolon 2.1.10 ### Changes - feat(release): add switchable stable/beta Sparkle channels - chore: commit remaining workspace changes - test(usage): cover scheduled refresh policy windows - feat(usage): adopt policy-driven refresh scheduling - test(codex): align auth/link assertions and isolate usage engine fixtures - refactor(codex): stabilize active account key and inject auth manager - feat(menu-bar): sort quick switch accounts by active and quota priority - chore(release): sync appcast for v2.1.9 ### Downloads | Platform | Architecture | Download | |----------|--------------|----------| | macOS | Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) | `nolon-arm64.dmg` | | macOS | Intel | `nolon-x86_64.dmg` | ### Installation 1. Download the appropriate DMG for your Mac - **Apple Silicon** (M1, M2, M3 chips): `nolon-arm64.dmg` - **Intel** (older Macs): `nolon-x86_64.dmg` 2. Open the DMG and drag nolon to Applications 3. Launch nolon from Applications ### System Requirements - macOS 14.0 or later --- *Built on 2026-04-03*

## nolon 2.1.11 ### Changes - feat(codex): ship advanced config and binary release notes - feat: add nolon agents management - feat: expand provider agents support - feat(agents-link): add nolon unified agents linking with placeholder and menu - fix(mcp-link): stabilize codex projection sync and add deletion regressions - test(concurrency): mark codex refresh helper nonisolated - fix(mcp-sync): propagate mcps deletions to all linked providers - fix(mcp-sync): avoid no-op rewrites that trigger config.toml watch loops - fix(mcp-sync): propagate ~/.nolon/mcps changes to linked providers - feat(mcp-ui): add MCP link menu beside search with dedicated mcpLinkEnabled state - fix(ui): decouple MCP tab placeholder from skills-link state - fix(ui): show MCP-specific link placeholder artwork and copy on MCP tab - fix(ui): show linked-to-nolon placeholder on MCP tab and hide add button when linked - feat(ui): add linked skills placeholder artwork and stable add-button hide - feat(providers): add fragment-first MCP sync with provider-native projection - chore: commit all remaining workspace changes - feat(provider): show linked placeholder and hide add action for skills link - feat(usage): codex tiered refresh with zero-quota throttle ### Downloads | Platform | Architecture | Download | |----------|--------------|----------| | macOS | Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) | `nolon-arm64.dmg` | | macOS | Intel | `nolon-x86_64.dmg` | ### Installation 1. Download the appropriate DMG for your Mac - **Apple Silicon** (M1, M2, M3 chips): `nolon-arm64.dmg` - **Intel** (older Macs): `nolon-x86_64.dmg` 2. Open the DMG and drag nolon to Applications 3. Launch nolon from Applications ### System Requirements - macOS 14.0 or later --- *Built on 2026-04-08*
